server.Einzige Pflicht: Bei einer Weitergabe vo: The only obligation: when Hatchtower is redistributed, the license and copyright notices of the libraries must be included. The file THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt, regenerated on every installation, takes care of this.
server.certifi (Liste vertrauenswürdiger Zertif: certifi (list of trusted certificates) is under the MPL 2.0. It is used unmodified; only changes to certifi itself would have to be disclosed.
server.Hatchtower bringt keine fremden Schrifte: Hatchtower ships no third-party fonts, icons, images or JavaScript libraries and loads nothing from external servers. Interface, logo and symbols are self-made; the font is the device's system font.
server.Python-Pakete dieser Installation, wie s: Python packages of this installation, as installed:
server.Laufzeitumgebung, aus dem Betriebssystem: Runtime, installed from the operating system
server.Betriebssystem des Servers, wird nicht m: Server operating system, not distributed with Hatchtower
server.nur über die offiziellen Schnittstellen: connected only via the official interfaces (API and websocket), no code taken over
server.Abfrage öffentlicher Serverinformationen: query of public server information via python-a2s
server.optional, nur wenn du einen Webhook eint: optional, only if you enter a webhook
server.Pterodactyl, Steam/Valve und Discord sin: Pterodactyl, Steam/Valve and Discord are trademarks of their respective owners. They are mentioned only descriptively; Hatchtower is an independent project and not affiliated with them.
server.Spiele-Logos und eigene Logos laden die: Game logos and custom logos are uploaded by the users themselves. The rights belong to the respective manufacturers. For private use in the admin area this is common; on a public status page you should only show logos you are allowed to use.
server.Repository privat oder noch kein Release: Repository private or no release yet – set a token with: hatchtower github-token
server.GitHub-Token abgelehnt – neu setzen mit:: GitHub token rejected – set a new one with: hatchtower github-token
server.Hatchtower jetzt auf Version {v} aktuali: Update Hatchtower to version {v} now? The interface will be unavailable for about a minute. The database is backed up first; if the new version does not start, it rolls back automatically.
server.Das Update über die Oberfläche steht ab: Updating from the interface is available from the next version on. This time, please run as root on the server:
server.Hatchtower prüft zweimal am Tag automati: Hatchtower checks automatically twice a day and never installs on its own. Manual checks are possible at most every 5 minutes.
server.Bitte warten: Erneut suchen ist in {n} S: Please wait: checking again is possible in {n} seconds.
server.Das Update über die Oberfläche ist hier: Updating from the interface is not set up here yet.
server.Es ist kein neueres Update bekannt. Bitt: No newer update is known. Please check for updates first.
server.Während des Neustarts ist die Oberfläche: During the restart the interface is briefly unavailable. This page keeps checking on its own and tells you when everything is done.
server.Keine Störungen in den letzten {n} Tagen: No incidents in the last {n} days.
server.Community-Discord (Einladungslink oder C: Community Discord (invite link or code, empty = hide)
server.Discord: bitte einen Einladungslink wie: Discord: please enter an invite link like https://discord.gg/abc123 or just the code
server.Die Sitzung ist abgelaufen oder das Rech: The session has expired or the permission was revoked.
server.gesetzt – leer lassen = unverändert: set – leave empty to keep it
server.Manuelles Passwort entfernen (dann gilt: Remove manual password (the one from Pterodactyl applies then)
server.Das Passwort darf den Benutzernamen nich: The password must not contain the username.
server.Zeitpläne für diesen Server anlegen, pau: Create, pause and delete schedules for this server and switch restart after crash on or off. Only actions the user is allowed to perform themselves can be scheduled.
server.eine Aktion, für die du das Recht hast: an action you have the permission for
server.Vorwarn-Befehl nur mit dem Recht „Befehl: warning command only with the permission “Send commands”
server.übersprungen: dem Ersteller fehlt das Re: skipped: the creator no longer has the permission
server.CPU-Auslastung dauerhaft hoch: CPU usage high for a long time
server.CPU seit {m} Minuten über {pct} % des Li: CPU above {pct} % of the limit for {m} minutes ({used} % of {limit} %).
server.CPU wird nur bei Servern mit CPU-Limit i: CPU is only checked for servers with a CPU limit in Pterodactyl (e.g. 400 % = 4 cores). 100 % means the limit is fully used.
server.Hatchtower bekommt von Pterodactyl keine: Hatchtower no longer receives data from Pterodactyl ({grund}). The states shown are out of date until the panel responds again.
server.Pterodactyl antwortet wieder (Ausfall et: Pterodactyl is responding again (outage about {n} minutes).
server.Der Serverstatus kann gerade nicht abgef: The server status cannot be retrieved right now.
server.Hatchtower bekommt keine aktuellen Daten: Hatchtower is not receiving current data. The servers are therefore shown as “no current data” – whether they are actually running is unknown right now.
server.Rechte gespeichert. Achtung: „{gruppe}“: Permissions saved. Note: “{gruppe}” contains control or write permissions – {name} can therefore control every newly added server right away.
server.Neuer Server „{name}“ in Pterodactyl. Au: New server “{name}” in Pterodactyl. Automatically shared with: {wer}. Status page and restart after crash are still off for it.
server.„Alle Server“ gilt für jeden Server ohne: “All servers” applies to every server without its own setting – including servers added to Pterodactyl later. A per-server setting always wins, “No access” excludes a server.
server.aus – nur die unten zugewiesenen Server: off – only the servers assigned below
server.Achtung: Diese Gruppe enthält Steuer- od: Note: this group contains control or write permissions. {name} could then start, stop or change every newly added server right away – test servers included. Read-only groups are usually the better fit for “All servers”.
server.Noch für niemanden freigegeben (nur Owne: Not shared with anyone yet (owners only).
server.Statusseite und Neustart nach Absturz si: Status page and restart after crash are still off.
server.Zurzeit sind keine Server für die Status: No servers are currently shown on the status page.
server.Weitere {n} Server stehen auf der Status: {n} more servers are listed on the status page.
server.Discord: Kanal-Einstellungen → Integrati: Discord: channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy URL. The address is stored encrypted.
server.Bitte eine Discord-Webhook-Adresse einge: Please enter a Discord webhook address (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…)
server.Jeder, der den Kanal sehen kann, kann da: Anyone who can see the channel can then read the passwords of the listed servers (hidden as spoilers).
server.Ich habe verstanden, dass die Passwörter: I understand that the passwords are visible in the channel.
server.Passwörter wurden nicht freigegeben: Bit: Passwords were not enabled: please confirm explicitly that they will be visible in the Discord channel.
server.Hatchtower postet eine Nachricht in eine: Hatchtower posts a message to a Discord channel (several for many servers) and keeps it up to date (checked every minute). It shows the same servers as the status page; the details are chosen separately here. Links to the status page and to server management appear at the top. Ideally use a dedicated channel that only Hatchtower writes to.
server.Das mitgeschriebene Konsolen-Archiv durc: Search and download the recorded console archive.
server.z. B. wer das ist oder woher das Konto k: e.g. who this is or where the account comes from
server.Einladungslink (gilt {n} Tage, nur einma: Invitation link (valid for {n} days, single use)
server.Einladungslink (gilt {n} Tage, für {k} K: Invitation link (valid for {n} days, for {k} accounts)
server.Einladungslink (gilt {n} Tage, beliebig: Invitation link (valid for {n} days, unlimited uses)
server.z. B. für wen der Link ist: e.g. who the link is for

browser.<strong>Dein Browser zeigt die Desktop-V: Your browser is showing the desktop version. That's why everything is so small.
browser.Öffne das Browser-Menü (⋮ oben rechts) u: Open the browser menu (⋮ at the top right) and untick “Desktop site”.
browser.Danach passt sich die Seite deinem Handy: The page will then adapt to your phone.
browser.Kill beendet den Prozess sofort, ohne zu: Kill ends the process immediately without saving. Continue?
browser.ZIP wird erstellt, der Download startet: Creating ZIP, the download will start shortly. Large folders take a while.
browser.Für keinen der ausgewählten Server erlau: Not allowed for any of the selected servers.
browser.Passwörter werden für jeden im Internet: Passwords become visible to anyone on the internet who opens the status page. Really enable?
browser.Das Update ist fehlgeschlagen. Hatchtowe: The update failed. Hatchtower keeps running with the previous version – see the log for details.
browser.Update angefordert – startet in wenigen: Update requested – starting in a few seconds …
browser.Das dauert ungewöhnlich lange. Bitte auf: This is taking unusually long. Please check on the server: journalctl -u hatchtower-update
